Name: Kupa Pixel Portrait Ver2
Author: kupado
Description:
[b][size=4]Installation instructions[/size][/b]
1. Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url]
2. Install the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/999]Portraiture[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/24534]PortraiturePlus[/url]
3. Extract the downloaded "Kupa Pixel Portrait Ver2.zip" file. Copy the resulting "Portraiture" and "PortraitureOpeningFix" folders and paste them directly into your "Mods" folder
 (Default path: C:\Program Files (x86)\Steam\steamapps\common\Stardew Valley\Mods)
overwriting any existing files if prompted.

[b][size=4]Main features[/size][/b]
These are HD pixel portraits designed specifically for the large screen display feature of the Portraiture mod. 
It is configured to automatically apply these custom portraits and the large screen display right from the opening scene.

Please note that depending on your display resolution, the portraits might stick out horizontally from the message box. 
If this happens, please adjust your UI Scale in the game settings.
For example, if you are playing at 4K resolution, setting the UI Scale to 110% works perfectly.

[b][size=4]SVE?[/size][/b]
Because the original creator does not allow AI modifications, I cannot publish it on Nexus Mods.

[b][size=4]Credits & Thanks[/size][/b]
Special thanks to the creators of these essential tools and frameworks that made this mod possible:

* SMAPI by Pathoschild
* Portraiture by Platonymous
* PortraiturePlus by Arborsm[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/65169671][/url]
